title: Recording: Cook Of The House by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings finished recording the vocals for the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Cook Of The House’ on 17 February 1976.

The session lasted from 7.30-11pm, and, as with the previous evening’s work, was for the backing vocals. They were performed by Paul McCartney and Denny Laine.
